description_en: Modifies the IP addresses in a whitelist of an ApsaraDB for SelectDB instance
description_zh: 修改指定云数据库SelectDB版实例的白名单IP
kebab_example: aliyun selectdb modify-security-ip-list --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id selectdb-cn-7213cjv0000 --group-name default --security-ip-list 127.0.XX.XX,127.2.XX.XX --modify-mode 0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifySecurityIPList

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the whitelist. Default value: Default
parameters.help_zh: 白名单分组名称。默认修改Default分组
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en: The IP addresses in the whitelist of the instance. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 实例的IP白名单，多个IP地址请用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: security_ip_list

parameters.help_en:
The mode in which you want to modify the whitelist. Valid values:

0: overwrites the IP addresses in the whitelist.

1: adds IP addresses to the whitelist.

2: removes IP addresses from the whitelist
parameters.help_zh:
白名单修改模式，取值说明：

0：覆盖原白名单。
1：增加白名单。
2：删除白名单
parameters.name: modify_mode
